mcqs.q: Why was the monarchy restored in 1660?
options: After Cromwell's death the Protectorate collapsed; General Monck negotiated Charles II's return on the terms of the Declaration of Breda (amnesty, religious flexibility, army pay).
Parliament voted to restore the monarchy because Cromwell had taxed them too heavily.
Hitler called off the attack to invade the USSR immediately.
Charles II invaded England with a French army and seized the throne.
